name: riya-level-series
description: riya level 12 · Series — geometric series and limits. Hop up the halving staircase 1 + ½ + ¼ + … toward the ceiling 2, then choose the limit to cross the final gap. Catch 5 ★! Composed from std-platformer-body + std-objective-flow + std-fx-particles + std-pickup + std-tutorial-overlay, rendered through math-canvas so the steps, hops, and ceiling stay visible. Rebound into the riya-game-platformer organism (menu + all worlds).

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

events.description: Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.
events.name: Curve Mod Clear

previewTrait.description: Trait rendered in the media position of the modal — the live, demo-driven preview of the mechanic (a bare game canvas, no shell chrome). '@trait.TutorialEmptyPreview' leaves the slot blank. Override with '@trait.<TraitName>' to show a board's live frame.

steps.description: One row per tutorial page: title, one line of body copy, and an optional demoId that plays a scripted live demo (std-tutorial-autodemo) for the mechanic being taught.

emits.description: Self-emitted on INIT when autoShow is on — opens step one. (A config-valued INIT guard would be constant-folded at compose time and misfire; the self-event keeps the decision in an effect.)
Advance one step; on the last step it finishes the tutorial (marks done, clears the overlay, emits TUTORIAL_DONE).
Return one step (inert on the first).
Skip/close the tutorial; marks done and clears the overlay.
Re-open the tutorial from step one — wire a board's help button here.
The tutorial was finished or skipped; boards unpause or log completion.
Emitted when a tutorial step carrying a demoId is shown; the composed std-tutorial-autodemo atom plays that scripted demo.
Emitted when the tutorial leaves a demo step (next/back) or is dismissed/finished; the autodemo atom stops and releases control.

features.description: One row per collectible: id, center (x, y in world units), board-defined kind (star, boost, …), display glyph and message floated on pickup. collected is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pickups — SET_FEATURES replaces it at runtime (boards that import collectibles), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected features survive respawns.
features.label: Features

reachX.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact.
reachX.label: Reach X

reachY.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact; generous values catch fly-through pickups.
reachY.label: Reach Y

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED collects touched features; toggle to freeze the set as-is.
running.label: Running

emits.description: The player touched an uncollected feature; carries the feature identity, board-defined kind (star, boost, …), position and display glyph/message. Fires once per feature per run.
Running count of collected features after this pickup — the event std-gate-lock consumes to count openings.
Every feature in the set is collected; fires once per run.

events.description: The player touched an uncollected feature; carries the feature identity, board-defined kind (star, boost, …), position and display glyph/message. Fires once per feature per run.
events.name: Picked

events.description: Running count of collected features after this pickup — the event std-gate-lock consumes to count openings.
events.name: Collect

events.description: Every feature in the set is collected; fires once per run.
events.name: Pickup Set Completed

ceilingStars.description: Unreachable bonus cluster floating above the ceiling y = 2 — visible but not collectible, emphasizing the felt limit.
ceilingStars.label: Ceiling Stars

default.hint: the halving steps settle at their ceiling

choiceGates.description: Limit gate at the final gap: three option platforms labeled 1, 2, ∞; only 2 is solid, the others are hazards. Render data only — collision is carried by the opt-* platform bars.
choiceGates.label: Choice Gates

concept.default: geometric series 1 + ½ + ¼ + … approaches the ceiling 2; the hops shrink by half each step; the limit gate asks for the unreachable sum
concept.label: Concept

curveOverlay.description: The limit ceiling S = 2 drawn as a dashed line the steps approach but never cross.
curveOverlay.label: Curve Overlay

entryY.description: Run-surface height at the zone's left edge; the open world stitches its incoming bridge to this.
entryY.label: Entry Y

exitY.description: Run-surface height at the zone's right edge; the open world stitches its outgoing bridge to this.
exitY.label: Exit Y

guides.description: The ceiling / sum of the geometric series.
guides.label: Guides

hops.description: Number-line jump arcs showing each geometric term; each hop is half the previous.
hops.label: Hops

platforms.description: Canonical terrain — seeds the body authority's collision AND the canvas bars via RIYA_LEVEL_DATA. Step tops are the partial sums 1, 1.5, 1.75, … approaching 2; the three end options are the limit gate.
platforms.label: Platforms

regionColor.description: Zone band accent in the open world.
regionColor.label: Region Color

skateCurve.description: Canonical skate path — seeds the body authority's skate transport via RIYA_LEVEL_DATA. The staircase approach to the ceiling S = 2.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

stars.description: Canonical collectibles — seeds the pickup authority via RIYA_LEVEL_DATA. Five stars plus a term pad marking the common ratio r = ½ of the geometric series.
stars.label: Stars

worldName.description: This world's display name — the open world's zone banner reads it from RIYA_LEVEL_DATA.
worldName.label: World Name

emits.description: The zone's canonical static geometry + pedagogy, broadcast once on INIT in zone-local coordinates. This atom's own play trait consumes it to seed the body/pickup authorities and the render; the riya open-world organism consumes the same event and applies its zone offset, so standalone and composed can never diverge.

agencyTrait.description: Trait that provides player verbs and immediate response. Usually a rebinding of std-platformer-body, std-motion-body, or std-hero-nav.
agencyTrait.label: Agency trait

challengeTrait.description: Trait that provides the obstacle, decision, or opposition. Usually a rebinding of std-choice-gate, std-gate-lock, std-patrol-hazard, std-velocity-gate, std-loop-lock, or std-pad-lock.
challengeTrait.label: Challenge trait

feedbackTrait.description: Trait that provides visual, audio, or narrative feedback. Usually a rebinding of std-fx-particles, std-fx-narrative, std-tutorial-overlay, std-audio-cue, or std-zone-card.
feedbackTrait.label: Feedback trait

goalTrait.description: Trait that resolves the win condition. Usually a rebinding of std-objective-flow or std-objective-reach.
goalTrait.label: Goal trait

rewardTrait.description: Trait that provides collectibles or scoring. Usually a rebinding of std-pickup, std-score, std-xp, or std-gold.
